description: This file contains integration tests for the 'SystemCode' feature in the Fineract project, including creating, updating, deleting codes and code values, with assertions to verify correct behavior and handling of errors.

classes.name: SystemCodeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing system code creation, update, deletion, and validation scenarios, including checks for duplicate codes and system-defined codes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes REST-assured and request/response specifications.

methods.name: testCreateCode
methods.description: Tests creating a new code, verifying its creation, updating it, and deleting it, along with validation assertions.

methods.name: testPreventCreateDuplicateCode
methods.description: Verifies that creating a duplicate code returns an error and that deleting it works properly.

methods.name: testUpdateDeleteSystemDefinedCode
methods.description: Ensures that system-defined codes cannot be updated or deleted, validating error responses.

methods.name: testCodeValuesNotAssignedToTable
methods.description: Tests creating code values, updating them, deleting them, and validating proper error handling for invalid deletions.

methods.name: testCodeValuesAssignedToTable
methods.description: Disabled test placeholder for verifying code values assigned to tables, currently not implemented.
